descriptions.text: The Solana-based mini entertainment project DoodiPals suffered a private key leak. The attacker sold tokens from dozens of wallets and exchanged them for SOL, making a total profit of about 917 SOL (approximately $171,000 USD).

On October 21, 2025, DoodiPals suffered a private key leak on Solana, enabling a hacker to drain and convert DOODI tokens from dozens of project-linked addresses. Approximately 917 SOL, equating to around $171,000, was lost , matching the full token market cap. The team suspended operations and announced plans for a 1:1 compensated token relaunch after a security review. The root cause was an operational breach: private keys controlling project and treasury wallets were leaked or compromised, allowing the attacker to transfer and sell all associated assets. The precise mode of compromise was not disclosed in public records.
